1933, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 163 Cont.
Dec. 7 Rita Qagne - 14 mo. - ruptured bowel - can not keep anything on stomach. Eugene Dory - 43 - weak spells - fits - sign painter ... Mrs. Cath Loechner - 62 - Heart - stomach. Jerome Muldoon - 8 - Fits.
Rev. Fr. Sharpe Mrs. Babcock J.J. Burke Bedfor.
Page 164 Dec. 17 Mrs. Stella Sturtz - 34 - Husb. & 3 - sickly off and on 6 yrs. Very poorly since last February. Trouble started from time she gave a third blood transfusion to save her little 8 yr. son. He was saved ..... nervous & enemic. Enrolled perpetually To-day.
James Ryan Mack - 32 - in serious trouble - Charged with being in bad gang ....
Sasin Habib - 55 - gambles, neglects, abuses wife and large family, never goes to church.
Bay City Boy School - for 75 - threatened with collapse - now 18 boys - 2 on charity.
Dorothy Paye - 21 - in T. B. San. . . Mother died 3 weeks ago ..... fear she contacted.
Mr. Alger- 68 - leg amputated, fever, etc.
Dec. 20th Christmas Week-
Gert. Wallenweber - 36 - like fits or paralysis - 15 yrs ... special Mrs. M Leonard - 51 - Almost blind-Husband and sons out of work till just recently. worry ...
John Morris - 57 - palsey, ailing. Miss Schultz - 22 -
Casimir W .. Ki - 23 - nervous-break - sister in convent ... & oldest (other Sr.) T.B. had to leave convent ... still hopes to go back.
